summary: Climber slipped ~100 ft down a snowbank into a crevasse while descending Paiute Peak; companion remained with her and attempted CPR for several hours before hiking out for help. Body recovered the next morning and evacuated by National Guard helicopter.
location: Paiute Peak, Mitchell Lake Trailhead / Brainard Lake, Indian Peaks Wilderness
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff; National Guard helicopter
notes: Boulder County Sheriff case #15-4188; victim was a 44-year-old Denver woman climbing with a friend. Year confirmed via sheriff release and CPR report (prior run had it as ~mid-Sept 2024 from Mountain-Ear roundup).
